title: Canadian teacher's death inspires charity that has donated more than $5 million to children over 13 years
summary_full: A Canadian charity named Noelle's Gift to Children has reached a significant milestone by distributing $5 million. In the past year, the charity provided $259,200 in funding to two school boards. This funding assists students with essential items such as food, clothing, and healthcare needs. The charity originated in 2013 after a kindergarten teacher's tragic death.
